_review: DRAFT v1 — all nodes need balance review and effect-handler wiring (Phase 10.4). Numbers are first-pass estimates, not tuned.

nodes.name: Basic Piloting
nodes._review: Baseline. Works as gate to all three lanes.

nodes.name: Combat Reflexes
nodes._review: autofire_precision handler not yet written — NoOp warns at purchase. Wire in 10.4.

nodes.name: Weapon Drills
nodes._review: Ballistic-only on purpose (gunner lane = projectiles). Energy in ace lane.

nodes.name: Target Analysis
nodes._review: Overlaps with vanilla Gunnery Implants range bonus — size carefully. Consider cap.

nodes.name: Overwhelming Fire
nodes._review: Shield-bypass alternative in defender lane. Pick one or split further.

nodes.name: Weapon Apotheosis
nodes.desc: Piloted ship: +25% damage, +15% range, all weapon types. (Capstone)
nodes._review: Capstone numbers — 25% dmg + 15% range feels strong vs. vanilla Ordnance Expertise. Consider 20/10.

nodes.name: Throttle Mastery
nodes._review: top_speed stacks multiplicatively with safety-override type effects — verify in playtest.

nodes.name: Dancing Hull
nodes.desc: +15% turn rate and sideways acceleration, piloted ship.
nodes._review: Stacks with root_1 for +20% total maneuverability. Consider diminishing returns.

nodes.name: Flux Conditioning
nodes._review: Large number — vanilla Helmsmanship gives 15%. Maybe reduce to 0.15.

nodes.name: Impossible Geometries
nodes.desc: Piloted ship: zero-flux boost also applies with guns firing; +50% zero-flux threshold. (Capstone)
nodes._review: Signature capstone — behavior change, not just numbers. Handler is complex combat-plugin work.

nodes.name: Damage Control
nodes._review: Armor bonus as % of base — verify that's what the stat expects (may be flat add).

nodes.name: Shield Modulation
nodes.desc: -20% shield flux per damage taken, piloted ship.
nodes._review: Sign convention — negative = less flux absorbed per damage. Handler must mirror vanilla Shield Modulation semantics.

nodes.name: Hardened Plating
nodes._review: Overlaps with vanilla Polarized Armor; keep smaller than armor_bonus.

nodes.name: Ironhide
nodes.desc: Piloted ship: 25% damage taken reduction below 50% hull. (Capstone)
nodes._review: Conditional damage reduction — vanilla Polarized Armor pattern. Handler needs hull-% polling in combat plugin.

merges.name: Elite Pilot
merges.desc: Merge of Ace + Gunner lanes: adds +10% weapon damage AND +10% top speed.
merges._review: Post-capstone merge. parentLanes drives hybrid-column placement; prereqs enforce both capstones owned.
